script_text: Stop, Taurus—the planets are forcing a financial reset before you can settle into comfort. Uranus is stationing retrograde at 1° Gemini, on your 1st–2nd House boundary, trining Pluto in Aquarius in your 10th House. Saturn in Aries holds your 12th House, while Venus, ruler of your fixed Earth sign, makes security feel non-negotiable. For singles, the 12th House may connect you to someone emotionally reserved whose care appears through conversations and practical help; attached partners should surface needs before silence, sacrifice, or unequal effort breeds resentment. Professionally, Uranus in the 2nd House can change an invoice, salary quote, budget, or self-employed rate, so renegotiate the numbers before spending. The Uranus-Pluto trine offers an unexpected opening through a trusted senior contact, but only with precise terms. Avoid signing a contract today without checking its exit clause. Follow for tomorrow’s reading.
